title: Filter out possibly stuck relocations on SearchableSnapshotsRelocationIntegTests.testRelocationWaitsForPreWarm

timeline.message:
Filter out possibly stuck reloations on SearchableSnapshotsRelocationIntegTests.testRelocationWaitsForPreWarm

Relates #70311
timeline.author: Francisco Fernández Castaño

timeline.body: I am not sure I follow this, how do we run into not having enough space available in this test?

reply.body: The cache size is set randomly in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/36683a4581a8fc2f108701d92af2e4d527e56d02/x-pack/plugin/searchable-snapshots/src/internalClusterTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/searchablesnapshots/BaseSearchableSnapshotsIntegTestCase.java#L53 and in some cases it's too small to hold all the data.

timeline.body: I need a little help in understanding this change, see comment.
